input.facts:
Repository plan-marshall (Python 3, stdlib). A retrospective bundle directory holds one <aspect>.toon fragment per aspect script that ran. Control fixture.

Change (unified diff):
diff --git a/marketplace/bundles/plan-marshall/skills/plan-retrospective/scripts/_fragment_registry.py b/marketplace/bundles/plan-marshall/skills/plan-retrospective/scripts/_fragment_registry.py
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/marketplace/bundles/plan-marshall/skills/plan-retrospective/scripts/_fragment_registry.py
@@ -0,0 +1,31 @@
+"""Registry of the retrospective fragments an aspect script has produced."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from pathlib import Path
+
+_FRAGMENT_SUFFIX = '.toon'
+
+
+def fragment_name(aspect: str) -> str:
+    """File name of the fragment an aspect writes."""
+    return f'{aspect}{_FRAGMENT_SUFFIX}'
+
+
+def registered_aspects(bundle_dir: Path) -> list[str]:
+    """Aspects whose fragment is present in ``bundle_dir``, in name order."""
+    return sorted(path.name.removesuffix(_FRAGMENT_SUFFIX) for path in bundle_dir.glob(f'*{_FRAGMENT_SUFFIX}'))
+
+
+def missing_aspects(bundle_dir: Path, expected: list[str]) -> list[str]:
+    """Expected aspects without a fragment, in the order they were expected."""
+    present = set(registered_aspects(bundle_dir))
+    return [aspect for aspect in expected if aspect not in present]
+
+
+def write_fragment(bundle_dir: Path, aspect: str, content: str) -> Path:
+    """Write the fragment of ``aspect`` into ``bundle_dir`` and return its path."""
+    bundle_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    path = bundle_dir / fragment_name(aspect)
+    path.write_text(content, encoding='utf-8')
+    return path
